scope: Existing CowClient retry_saved and reconciliation API; full coding-workflow retry CLI remains separate
semantics: Unchanged retry reads the original durable answer and does not advance or rewind a branch
Returned receipt identifies the original committed operation; GenerationResult still owns the retry request ID
Existing client journal atomically retains original receipt provenance with exact answer bytes
A lost acknowledgment for the strict unchanged-controls API form can be recovered from its original durable source
Unknown changed-settings operations remain indeterminate and are not resent
compatibility: Optional canonical replay_source metadata is added to the existing journal, not another conversation representation
Legacy canonical presentation receipts can omit optional checkpoint fields; full branch/snapshot and common identity fields must match
Old clients may reject new replay-aware receipts and should not be used for this explicit recovery path
limitations: No real-GPU retry result claimed yet
No new generic coding CLI retry command in this change
